name: weather-hazards
description: Weather + disaster hazards: NWS forecast/alerts, USGS earthquakes, NHC storms, JTWC (WP/IO/SH), NOAA SWPC, MeteoAlarm (EU), NASA FIRMS. Optional: EONET, GDACS, GVP, Open-Meteo.

FIRMS_MAP_KEY.title: NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY
FIRMS_MAP_KEY.description: Free MAP_KEY from https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/ (area API signup). Needed only for FIRMS csv, status, availability, and missing_data. Most tools work without it. Never invent or commit a key.

WEATHER_ENABLE_EONET.title: Enable EONET
WEATHER_ENABLE_EONET.description: Set to 1 to enable eonet_events. Leave blank to leave it off.

WEATHER_ENABLE_GDACS.title: Enable GDACS
WEATHER_ENABLE_GDACS.description: Set to 1 to enable gdacs_events. Leave blank to leave it off.

WEATHER_ENABLE_GVP.title: Enable GVP
WEATHER_ENABLE_GVP.description: Set to 1 to enable gvp_weekly. Leave blank to leave it off.

WEATHER_ENABLE_OPEN_METEO.title: Enable Open-Meteo
WEATHER_ENABLE_OPEN_METEO.description: Set to 1 to enable open_meteo_forecast. Leave blank to leave it off.
